in_arabic.name: Anasa
in_arabic.long_meaning: Anasa هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-n', meaning 'to give' or 'to provide'. In Islamic history, Anas ibn Malik was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his generosity and hospitality.
